Plumbing Services in Olive Branch, MS

Honest Plumbing for DeSoto County & the Memphis Suburbs Since 1994

Olive Branch Plumbing Co. has served homes and businesses across North Mississippi and West Tennessee for over 30 years. Terry Gross started the company to give his community a plumber it could trust, and today his daughter Angel and the family carry it on from our shop on Highway 178.

Continue Reading

When you call, you reach our office in Olive Branch, not a national call center. Our plumbers are licensed in Mississippi, Tennessee and Arkansas, bonded and insured, and paid hourly, so there's never a reason to upsell you. From a dripping faucet to a commercial build-out, the same family stands behind the work.

What Sets Our Family Apart

Plenty of companies can unclog a drain. Here's why DeSoto County keeps calling us.

A real family, not a franchise

Founded in 1994 by Terry Gross and run today by his daughter Angel and the family. When you call, you reach our office in Olive Branch, not a national call center.

Plumbers paid hourly, never on commission

Lots of shops pay techs to sell. We don't. Our plumbers are paid hourly, so the only goal is fixing what's actually broken.

Honest answers, even when it costs us

One customer was quoted “thousands” elsewhere for banging pipes. We found a half-closed valve and fixed it in seconds. That's how we work.

Licensed in 3 states

Licensed in Mississippi, Tennessee and Arkansas, and bonded and insured, so you're covered on both sides of the state line.

Same-day service and emergency help

Same-day appointments are available, and emergency plumbing service is too. Burst pipes don't wait, and neither do we.

Homes and businesses, one team

From a dripping faucet to commercial projects up to half a million dollars, the same trusted family handles every job.

Meet the Olive Branch Family

Started by a dad. Carried on by his daughter.

Terry Gross opened Olive Branch Plumbing in 1994 to give this community a plumber it could trust. After his unexpected passing in 2001, his daughter Angel took the wheel. She grew the business through the building boom, held it together through 2008, and kept the doors open for the neighbors who counted on it.

Questions & Answers

Do you handle plumbing emergencies?

Yes. Our services page lists 24/7 emergency plumbing. If water is actively leaking, shut off your main water valve if you can, then call us at 662-893-0346. Please call for emergencies; don't use the form.

What are your business hours?

Our office is open Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm office hours: Google shows M–F 7–4, Birdeye shows Mon–Sat 7–5]

Do your plumbers work on commission?

No. Our plumbers are paid hourly, not on commission, so nobody is rewarded for upselling you. Like we say: if it isn't broke, we aren't going to fix it.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. We're licensed in Mississippi, Tennessee and Arkansas, and our plumbers are bonded and insured. License numbers: [PLACEHOLDER: MS / TN / AR license numbers]

Do you offer same-day service?

Yes, we offer same-day service. Call early in the day for the best chance at a same-day slot.

How much does a service call cost? Are estimates free?

Honesty is one of our core values, and we'll never sell you work you don't need. Call or book online to request an estimate. [PLACEHOLDER: service-call / trip fee and whether estimates are free]
